Your responsibilities include: Picking and preparing customer orders for shipment Counting, checking, and managing inventory Printing labels and preparing packages Processing returns accurately Packing shipments andpreparing them for transport No two days are exactly the same, and you’ll be working in a team where everyone plays an important role. No experience? No problem! You don’t need previous logistics experience to get started. We’ll teach you everything you need to know. Because you’ll be working with pharmaceutical products, accuracy and quality are extremely important. That’s why you’ll receive a comprehensive onboarding and training program from day one. You’ll learn the processes step by step and receive support from experienced colleagues. And your development doesn’t stop there. At DHL, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to learn new skills, obtain valuable certificates, and grow within the company. You could even progress into a role such as Team Leader in the future!
